changelog: Hogwarts Legacy & Sekiro Per-Game sRGB Profile Isolation v0.1.10
features: Per-Game sRGB Correction: Dynamic constant buffer control enables rich contrast on DX12/UE4 linear surfaces (Hogwarts Legacy) while preserving monitor-accurate daylight on DX11 sRGB surfaces (Sekiro)
Zero Cross-Game Regressions: Color grading is strictly profile-isolated without global hardcoded shader overrides
Live In-Game Toggle: VR overlay allows real-time sRGB toggle for fine-tuning
Dev-Mode Precedence: Launcher prioritizes local build outputs over stale OTA cache during development
fixes: Fixed Hogwarts Legacy (DX12) appearing washed out, milky, and low contrast in VR headset
Guaranteed Sekiro stays daylight bright without double-gamma crush
Synchronized DX12, DX11, and Vulkan constant buffer layouts to 256 bytes with SrgbCorrection flag
